verdicts: Fair test: the loop actually expands (every world at least once, median at least 3 expansions)
expansions median 4, min 2; concepts 72; worlds with >=2 expansions scored for slopes 48
Across the whole loop the persistent learner beats the same learner with no memory: mean share of ceiling minus control, above 0
Within each finite stage the learner improves: mean over stages of (later half minus earlier half share), above 0
VERTICAL ACROSS EXPANSIONS: the advantage over no memory on the first problems after an expansion grows with each expansion (slope over stages, above 0)
The learner keeps up with growing complexity: share at the end of each stage does not fall across stages (slope above 0)
